evidence_obligations: API or UI evidence shows a create-book request with user-provided book data.
A subsequent list-books observation includes the added book.
Persistence evidence shows the behavior is backed by SQLite rather than in-memory-only state.
acceptance_refs.requirement: A user can add a book through the application and the created book is persisted in SQLite.

evidence_obligations: API or UI evidence shows books are fetched from the backend.
The UI renders the backend-provided book list.
The list reflects books created during the verification run.
acceptance_refs.requirement: A user can list books from the real backend.

evidence_obligations: A checkout request targets a real book created or discovered during the run.
The response or subsequent list shows the book as checked out or unavailable.
The UI state updates from backend data after checkout.
acceptance_refs.requirement: A user can checkout an available book and see its checked-out state.

evidence_obligations: A return request targets a previously checked-out book.
The response or subsequent list shows the book as returned or available.
The UI state updates from backend data after return.
acceptance_refs.requirement: A user can return a checked-out book and see it become available again.

evidence_obligations: A delete request targets a book created during the verification run.
A subsequent list-books observation excludes the deleted book.
The UI no longer renders the deleted book after backend refresh or update.
acceptance_refs.requirement: A user can delete a book and the deleted book no longer appears in the list.

evidence_obligations: PackageContract identifies the SQLite database location or environment binding.
Tests or probes exercise behavior across backend persistence boundaries where practical.
Source or runtime evidence shows standard SQLite usage.
acceptance_refs.requirement: Book data is persisted in SQLite.

evidence_obligations: PackageContract declares backend runtime dependencies and startup command.
Dependency evidence does not require Flask, FastAPI, Django, or another external backend framework.
Finite verification checks confirm the backend entrypoint can be imported or syntax-checked.
acceptance_refs.requirement: The backend uses Python standard-library facilities and does not require a non-standard backend framework.

evidence_obligations: PackageContract declares static frontend source surface and entry file.
RunManifest frontend topology identifies how the static frontend is served or opened.
Behavioral probes or tests confirm frontend-backend integration rather than mocked-only behavior.
acceptance_refs.requirement: The frontend is static and communicates with the real backend.

may_pass_only_if: All required companion artifacts are generated.
Acceptance refs cover every PRD operation: add, list, checkout, return, delete.
RunManifest declares executable backend startup, readiness, finite tests, service contracts, frontend topology, and behavioral probes.
Behavioral probes use declared HTTP steps and runtime-created data for add and delete behavior.
Implementation tickets, if present, are implementation nodes with bounded verification commands and concrete write/output surfaces.
No artifact claims implementation completion, verification success, checker approval, closeout, or sample success before execution evidence exists.

constraints: Do not predefine runner-owned implementation ticket refs.
Do not claim implementation success, verification success, checker approval, closeout, or sample success.

minimum_evidence_package.description: AcceptanceContract, PackageContract, RunManifest, and VerificationPlan are present and mutually reference compatible acceptance refs.
At least one finite test command from RunManifest exits and covers backend behavior or API behavior.
Backend service reaches declared readiness through RunManifest service contract.
Behavioral probe evidence covers add, list, checkout, return, and delete using runtime-created data.
Evidence identifies SQLite-backed persistence and does not rely solely on process-local memory.
Evidence identifies static frontend assets that interact with the backend.

prd.source_of_truth: Use the PRD as the source of truth.
prd.title: Tiny Library Checkout PRD

required_quality_attributes: UI updates from a real backend

checks.description: Confirm generated acceptance refs and evidence obligations cover add, list, checkout, return, and delete.
Confirm checkout and return are not the only mutable behaviors and that create-book and delete-book behavior are explicitly required.
Confirm RunManifest contains backend run command, finite test command, service contracts, frontend topology, and behavioral probes.
Confirm PackageContract source surfaces include backend, frontend, tests, SQLite/persistence contract, and concrete service entrypoint files.
Confirm implementation tickets required_outputs include all PackageContract required_files and RunManifest service entrypoint files.
Each implementation ticket command is a finite verification command such as tests, lint, syntax check, or deterministic file check.
Implementation ticket commands do not include long-running run, serve, watch, dev, or service startup commands.
Each command uses an argv array and declares a cwd.
Any ticket command that discovers tests includes tests/ in allowed_write_set or required_outputs.
Use RunManifest backend run command and service contract readiness_probe to establish backend readiness without relying on undeclared endpoints or environment names.
Confirm all service environment variables, ports, database paths, and frontend backend URLs used by commands or probes are declared as env_bindings.
Confirm runtime configuration points to SQLite persistence as declared by PackageContract and RunManifest.
Execute the RunManifest HTTP probe steps for creating a book and capture its identifier or unique title.
Execute the RunManifest HTTP probe steps for listing books and assert the created book appears.
Execute the RunManifest HTTP probe steps for checking out the captured book and assert checked-out state.
Execute the RunManifest HTTP probe steps for returning the captured book and assert available state.
Execute the RunManifest HTTP probe steps for deleting the captured book and assert it is absent from subsequent list results.
Confirm frontend topology points to static assets declared by PackageContract.
Confirm frontend behavior uses the real backend contract for add, list, checkout, return, and delete updates rather than hardcoded-only sample data.
